brief: One system that runs a racket-sport academy: schedules, enrollments, attendance, billing, coach payouts and parent messages. The logo has to feel like an academy where players earn their level, energetic and sporty, for any racket sport.
criteria: Success: reads as an academy, fits any racket sport, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, uses the Rally palette.

concepts.name: Earned Stripes
concepts.idea: Levels earned, stacked like stripes; the newest one is volt.
rationale: Says academy: progression players earn, the way the app tracks skill levels
No racket or ball drawn, so tennis, badminton, pickleball and squash all fit
Three strokes on a 3:4 slope: holds at 16 px and in one colour

recommendation: Earned Stripes, chosen by the owner on 2026-11-03.
next_steps: Use on the website and PWA icons
